rules: Text plus synthesized SFX only (no voice audio, no music). Hold Enter / Space / pad A for 1 s to skip a cinematic; a skip still applies its end state (billboard text, flags). {name} is the chosen character name; the surname Sprock is fixed.

ops.CHIME: SERA three-tone chime on every screen and the phone

p2_heat_alert.title: CINEMATIC P.2 · THE HEAT ALERT
steps: Fony rolls to a stop in the middle of the Yard, breathing hard, drenched in sweat. Twenty minutes, and the sun is already brutal. He drinks the last inch of water from a dented bottle.
(warm, soothing, everywhere) Good morning. This is SERA, on behalf of the City of Glitchport and Dusk Dynamics. A Level Four Heat Emergency is now in effect.
To protect critical infrastructure, the Grid Priority Schedule is active. Residential power in lower-priority districts will be balanced throughout the day.
Public cooling centers are temporarily closed. Please stay indoors and stay comfortable.
NOTICE: The Sunburn Open qualifiers are postponed until the Heat Emergency ends. Dusk Dynamics thanks you for your patience.
He crumples the flyer, then smooths it out again and puts it back in his pocket. He sits down on the edge of the bowl.
Cooling centers closed to protect "critical infrastructure." Do you know what the critical infrastructure is?
The hospitals are fourth on the list. First are the computers that decide who gets power. They're very important to themselves.
Fony laughs despite himself, a short, bitter sound.
I'm mostly a weird power supply. The TV is the part with the face.

p3_flagged.title: CINEMATIC P.3 · FLAGGED
steps: A soft chime from above. Fony looks up.
A Warden welfare drone floats over the fence: small, white, rounded, a friendly blue smiley on a round screen. It's almost cute.
(chirpy) Hello! You look like you could use some support. Please hold still for a quick wellness check.
Fony is already standing. His hand is on his board.
Identity confirmed: Sprock, {name}. Status: unsupported dependent. Collection order active. Don't worry! A Dusk Dynamics care van is on its way. Please stay where you are.
The smiley doesn't change. Below it, a hatch opens and a soft restraint net folds out like a flower.
(fast, low) Gate is south. Don't use it. The fence on the east side has a gap behind the dumpster. Glass Row stairs, then back here through the drain. I'll open the arcade.
